45629-the-sky-pilot-s-great-chase-or-jac.title: Jack Ralston's Dead Stick Landing
45629-the-sky-pilot-s-great-chase-or-jac.creator: Ambrose Newcomb
45629-the-sky-pilot-s-great-chase-or-jac.description: A book by Ambrose Newcomb. The happy-go-lucky speaker was an old friend of ours, one Perk, and the companion to whom he addressed his question was his bosom pal, Jack Ralston of the U. Nevertheless, it seemed that Perk was now known as Gabe Smith, a woods guide of wide experience who in the course of his wanderings had managed to pick up a smattering of aviation, a particularly useful thing in these air-minded days.

arxiv-2108-10723.title: Improving 3D Object Detection with Channel-wise Transformer
arxiv-2108-10723.creator: Hualian Sheng, Sijia Cai, Yuan Liu, Bing Deng, Jianqiang Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua, Min-Jian Zhao
arxiv-2108-10723.description: Abstract Though 3D object detection from point clouds has achieved rapid progress in recent years, the lack of flexible and high-performance proposal refinement remains a great hurdle for existing state-of-the-art two-stage detectors. Previous works on refining 3D proposals have relied on human-designed components such as keypoints sampling, set abstraction and multi-scale feature fusion to produce powerful 3D object representations.

arxiv-2205-03912.title: An age-structured epidemic model with vaccination
arxiv-2205-03912.creator: Ruiyang Zhou, Fengying Wei
arxiv-2205-03912.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ruiyang Zhou, Fengying Wei. In this article, we construct an age-structured model for COVID-19 with vaccination and analyze it from multiple perspectives. We derive the unique disease-free equilibrium point and the basic reproduction number ℛ 0 \mathscr{R}_{0} , then we show that the disease-free equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable when ℛ 0 < 1 \mathscr{R}_{0}<1 , while is unstable when ℛ 0 > 1 \mathscr{R}_{0}>1 . We also work out endemic equilibrium points and reveal the stability.

arxiv-2207-03248.title: A heuristic for the non-unicost set covering problem using local branching
arxiv-2207-03248.creator: J.E. Beasley
arxiv-2207-03248.description: Abstract In this paper we present a heuristic for the non-unicost set covering problem using local branching. Local branching eliminates the need to define a problem specific search neighbourhood for any particular (zero-one) optimisation problem. It does this by incorporating a generalised Hamming distance neighbourhood into the problem, and this leads naturally to an appropriate neighbourhood search procedure.

arxiv-2211-02732.title: Multi-Fidelity Cost-Aware Bayesian Optimization
arxiv-2211-02732.creator: Zahra Zanjani Foumani, Mehdi Shishehbor, Amin Yousefpour, Ramin Bostanabad
arxiv-2211-02732.description: Abstract Abstract Bayesian optimization (BO) is increasingly employed in critical applications such as materials design and drug discovery. An increasingly popular strategy in BO is to forgo the sole reliance on high-fidelity data and instead use an ensemble of information sources which provide inexpensive low-fidelity data.

arxiv-2301-06464.title: Hunting the gamma-ray emission from Fast Radio Burst with Fermi-LAT
arxiv-2301-06464.creator: on behalf of the Fermi Large Area Telescope Collaboration
arxiv-2301-06464.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by on behalf of the Fermi Large Area Telescope Collaboration. Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are one of the most exciting new mysteries of astrophysics. Their origin is still unknown, but recent observations seem to link them to soft gamma repeaters and, in particular, to magnetar giant flares (MGFs). The recent detection of a MGF at GeV energies by the Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) motivated the search for GeV counterparts to the >100 currently known FRBs.

arxiv-2302-00281.title: Informationally Robust Cheap-Talk
arxiv-2302-00281.creator: Itai Arieli, Ronen Gradwohl, Rann Smorodinsky
arxiv-2302-00281.description: Abstract We study the robustness of cheap-talk equilibria to infinitesimal private information of the receiver in a model with a binary state-space and state-independent sender-preferences. We show that the sender-optimal equilibrium is robust if and only if this equilibrium either reveals no information to the receiver or fully reveals one of the states with positive probability.

pmc-12635402.title: Global environmental drivers shape Cenozoic neoselachian diversity and identify modern conservation priorities
pmc-12635402.creator: Manuel Andreas Staggl, Eduardo Villalobos-Segura, Michael J Benton, Jürgen Kriwet
pmc-12635402.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Sharks, rays and their immediate extinct ancestors (Neoselachii) are some of the ecologically most impactful marine vertebrates. Despite their evolutionary success, the deep-time patterns of neoselachian diversity and turnover as a response to environmental perturbations remain understudied. Past studies have focussed on taxonomic richness while neglecting changes in faunal composition and ecological strategies, limiting our understanding of macroevolutionary resilience and vulnerability of neoselachians. Consequently, the extent to which major Cenozoic environmental shifts affected neoselachian diversity and turnover remain elusive.

pmc-12796886.creator: Ke AN, Jing XIE, Xuedong ZHOU
pmc-12796886.description: 牙源性干细胞（dental stem cells, DSCs）是一类来源于牙齿及其周围组织的成体干细胞，因其具有较强的成骨/成牙本质分化能力，在牙齿及骨组织的再生研究中备受关注。最新研究表明，脂质代谢在干细胞生物学活动中发挥重要作用，甚至可作为决定细胞命运的重要因素。然而，脂质代谢在DSCs成骨/成牙本质分化过程中的具体作用及其调控机制，目前尚缺乏系统性的总结与深入阐释。本文基于最新研究进展，系统分析DSCs在成骨/成牙本质分化过程中脂质代谢的变化，并深入探讨这一过程的关键调控功能，以期为再生医学研究提供新的代谢调控视角与潜在干预策略。Keywords: 脂质代谢, 牙源性干细胞, 成骨分化, 成牙本质分化, 细胞命运调控, 综述 牙源性干细胞是一类源自牙齿及其周围组织的成体干细胞，根据其来源部位可分为牙囊干细胞（dental follicle stem cells, DFSC）、牙髓干细胞（dental pulp stem cells, DPSC）、牙周膜干细胞（periodontal ligament stem cells, PDLSC）、牙龈间充质干细胞（gingival mesenchymal stem cells, GMSC）、根尖乳头干细胞（stem cells from apical papilla, SCAP）、脱落乳牙牙髓干细胞（stem cells from human exfoliated deciduous teeth, SHED）等多种亚型（图1）[1]。这类干细胞均起源于颅神经嵴，因其具有较强的成骨/成牙本质分化潜能以及易于获取的独特优势，已成为推进牙齿及骨组织再生研究中极具潜力的种子细胞，展现出重要临床转化前景[2]。 Tissue origins of DSCs and their osteogenic/odontogenic differentiation DSCs来源及成骨/成牙本质分化 DSCs: dental stem cells; DFSCs: dental follicle stem cells; DPSCs: dental pulp

pmc-13437555.creator: Tianle Feng, Yuanjie Cui, Xinwen Bi, Yang Liu, Lian Yang, Dongyue Ouyang, Weixin Xu, Yanyan Zhao, Yuqin Xi, Qiong Yang, Yixin Sun, Xue Wang, Ming Li

pmc-13542628.title: Computational Design and Theoretical Evaluation of Novel Heterocyclic Energetic Materials Based on 5‐H‐Imidazo‐[4,5‐c]‐Pyridazine and 1,2,4‐Triazolo‐[4,3‐a]‐Pyrazine Scaffolds
pmc-13542628.creator: Luciana Amorim da Silva, Nathália Magalhães Paixão Rosa, Danillo Fernando Vianna Cantini, Aline Cardoso Anastácio
pmc-13542628.description: Novel energetic materials based on 5‐H‐imidazo‐[4,5‐c]‐pyridazine and 1,2,4‐triazolo‐[4,3‐a]‐pyrazine scaffolds, modified with explosophore groups (—NO2, —NHNO2, —N3, and —ONO2), were theoretically designed and evaluated by DFT at the B3LYP/def2‐TZVPP // B3LYP/6‐311G(d,p) level. Nitramino derivatives exhibited the highest chemical stability based on HOMO‐LUMO gap analysis. Heat of formation followed the trend —N3 > —NO2 > —NHNO2 > —ONO2.
